text:
nina (sales): Opening Lyra POC perf thread. Customer goal: 500 qps steady for chat completions, p95 <= 220ms on 256-token contexts. They want a short results writeup + a ballpark for scaling to 1k qps. Also need KMS answers for a small PHI subset. Who can take orchestration + one-pager?

omar (se): I can run the load and produce runbook. Plan: Dedicated-2 primary, hosted fallback. Test variants: rwd-7b-fp16 and rwd-4b-quant. Workload split 82/18 chat/embeds, embed batches of 512.

sasha (perf): Quick test plan: warmup 25m@180 qps, ramp 180->500 in 12m, sustain 60m@500, then 4 spikes at 1k qps for 25s each. Collect p50/p95/p99, per-token latency, batch sizes, GPU util, retry rate. Export CSV + PNGs to s3. Enable continuous batching and prefix cache.

ben (lyra): We can postpone PHI runs to Private if needed. Procurement wants the 72h Dedicated cost estimate and a monthly ops range for 1k qps asap. Also need a short note on fallback SLA if Dedicated degrades.

tara (security): If PHI present, Private + customer KMS + signed DPA required. Lead time ~10 business days after we get SP and allowlist. For now we can run non-PHI on Dedicated. Ben, please confirm PHI timing.

ci-bot: run started (id: lyra-777)  artifacts -> s3://perf-lyra/lyra-777/  warmup phase active.

sasha (perf): Warmup snapshot: rwd-7b p95 ~172ms @210 qps, p99 ~400ms, gpu util ~71%. rwd-4b-quant p95 ~195ms p99 ~460ms. Embedding throughput 2.2k v/s on dedicated nodes.

omar (se): Ops runbook snippet added: REDWOOD_RUN=lyra-777 REDWOOD_POOL=dedicated-2; flags: CONT_BATCHING=1 KV_CACHE=1; fallback routes to hosted rwd-7b with warm fallback policy. Also will run a controlled pod kill during sustain to show graceful degradation.

sasha (perf): Sustain done: 60m@500 qps achieved. Aggregate p95 = 210ms, p99 = 485ms, avg latency 100ms. Pod kill increased p99 to ~1.05s for ~80s before recovery. Spikes to 1k succeeded but embedding path errors rose ~0.4% at peaks. CSV+PNGs uploaded.

nina (sales): Ballpark costs (preliminary): 72h dedicated run ~ $3k - $4k. Monthly for 1k qps sustained ~ $65k - $90k depending on reservation and embed mix. I'll get finance a proper quote. Ben, confirm PHI timing so Tara can start KMS/DPA.

ben (lyra): We'll keep PHI for Private window. Proceed with Dedicated results. Melissa (procurement) will follow up for the vendor packet. Thanks team!
